A popular vlogger, Bryan Wu, sets out to capture viral-worthy footage of creatures and magic, under the guise of helping Yi and her friends get out their “creature awareness” message. Yi and the crew must step in when Bryan puts himself and creatures alike in peril in his pursuit of clickbait.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: The crew gets their first ping on their new creature-helping app! A dried up jellyfish-type creature has been discovered at a construction site, and the anti-creature contractor wants it GONE. The crew try taking Jelleen to the sewers to live with Sewer Koi, but the unhappy creature creates a blackout in the sewers with its magical electric charge. Realizing that Jelleen should be able to stay in her original home, the crew must stand up against the contractor and force her to see the error of her ways… or else!

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Circumstantial evidence has Birch certain Raffi's fallen in with a bad crowd. His frequent absences, new friends and secretive behaviour point to one thing for Birch who has a hard time convincing her friends. A note, its content misconstrued, finally convinces everyone of Raffi's dire predicament.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: An attempt to quell Liam's manic energy throws Birch into conflict. Does she continue helping her hyperactive cousin learn to relax or does she pull him into the school's Manga Slam? Will Liam become too relaxed or bring a never-before-seen energy to Cosmos High's stage?

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: After Birch watches a late night mockumentary on TV about aliens among us, she becomes a big ball of paranoia as she misinterprets her schoolmates' head twitches, hand gestures and overall comportment. What she doesn't know is they're planning a surprise party for her and are acting all mysterious around her.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Liam is asked to help out the soccer team when an injury sidelines Raffi. Immediately thrilled to be part of the team — any team — Liam's joy turns to humiliation when he realizes the other players want him to be the mascot, not an actual player.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: As Mother tries to get baby William to sleep, Olivia, Ian and Julian create a backyard parade. When Francine finds out, she decides she's going to make her OWN parade. Olivia eventually sees that two parades can be better than one –and even figures out how to keep fussy William asleep.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Julian comes down with a case of “itchyfootitis,” so it's Dr. Olivia to the rescue, with all kinds of silly treatments. When the “condition” begins to spread to others, Olivia imagines herself running an entire “itchy foot” clinic, and eventually discovers the perfect cure.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After noticing all the great compliments Mother receives on account of adorable baby William, Olivia finds herself some babies of her own: her cat Edwin and her dog Perry. Being a mum is tougher than it seems, but when Mother asks Olivia to watch William for a minute, her new skills come in handy.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Olivia and her family go to the beach, Olivia finds what she thinks is a pearl-making oyster. She enlists Ian and Julian to help her find more, imagining that they're pirates in search of buried treasure. In reality, Father explains that they've actually found clams: no pearls inside, but great for a clambake!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. / When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas' diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. / When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. / When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Fleshed Out Wolfie wakes up one morning to every creature's nightmare?he's turned into a human! Messy Business At The Manor When Mosshead has nowhere to go for vacation, Casper invites him to stay at his uncles' house…where he quickly discovers that Mosshead is the world's worst houseguest.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Paramedic Paranormal When Jimmy breaks out in hives, Casper and his friends have no choice but to bring him to the human hospital. Back To Ghoul When Casper's uncles Stinky, Fatso and Stretch decide to go back to Scare School, Casper is thrilled.

programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idefix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: Rocky & Lily : C'Est Dans La Boite !
programme.desc: Every day, Rocky and Lily receive a new box on the set. But what does it contain? It's always a surprising object that leads them to discover very different subjects: turtles, bowling or even cloud formation.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Levy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Championnat Du Monde D'Endurance Wec 2026
programme.desc: All the spirit of the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans in an American version for this fifth round of the Championship. On the Circuit of The Americas, the 6-hour Lone Star Le Mans is set to be the largest gathering of North American racing cars and manufacturers.

programme.title: L'Abime

programme.title: L'Abime

programme.title: Geopolitis
programme.desc: Analysis, explanations, neutrality... ''Geopolitis'' offers an unbiased in-depth look at international current affairs, with accuracy, precision and a constant desire to make an increasingly complex and conflictual world easier to understand.

programme.title: Jeunes Cathos, Fideles Malgre Tout
programme.desc: The Church has never attracted so few people. To survive, it must renew itself and attract new followers. Sophie, Martin, Celine and David have decided to give it a new lease of life. Who are these young practicing Catholics? Are they going against the current of the world around them? Interwoven portraits.

programme.title: Se Souvenir, L'Histoire Des Veterans Autochtones
programme.desc: Exempt from the draft, almost 10,000 indigenous people nevertheless enlisted under the Canadian flag during the two world wars and the Korean war. Some of them, like the elite sniper Francis Pegahmagabow, distinguished themselves through acts of bravery. But on their return home, they were sent back to their reserves. Narrative.

programme.title: Terra Artistika
programme.desc: It is in doing that I truly understand things. In the intimacy of his studio, we discover the secrets of Jean-Philippe Brunaud's artistic works and how they come into being.

programme.desc: Spelling, grammar, conjugation: these essential French concepts are approached by teachers in a fun way to help children aged 9-12.

programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs
programme.desc: Twin sisters Ranya and Syrine are as adorable as they are inseparable. Their lives are joyful and full of everyday adventures. But everything is about to be turned upside down with the arrival of their little brother, Jad.

programme.title: Mission Heros
programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi
programme.desc: The park is closed. Charlie and Compostman, who can't stand being deprived of nature, decide to bring nature home.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi
programme.desc: Big Oak, Charlie and Compostman's favorite tree, is about to be cut down to make way for a new playground. Charlie and Compostman want to save it.

programme.title: Les Triples
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: Chniwla Et Boubris
programme.desc: Boubris is an introverted lizard who dreams of peace and quiet. A former musician, he fled the hustle and settled away from the world. Until the day Chniwla, a hyperactive and intrusive mosquito, disrupts his daily life.

programme.title: Chniwla Et Boubris

programme.title: Cirkus
programme.desc: Aria helps Fauve and Kenzo create a number for the circus whilst Madame Loyal the ringmistress tries to reconcile the two cousins.

programme.title: Ma Vie Avec L'Ia
programme.desc: Theo, a teenager, questions artificial intelligence directly to try to understand it better. He wants to know what it is made of, what feeds it, and how it analyzes data.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Mission Info
programme.desc: News programme aimed at 7 to 11-year-olds! Each episode, devised for children and their parents, provides insight accessible to younger ones, combined with explanations, immersive reports and expert interviews. An educational quiz also gives children the chance to test their knowledge in a fun way.

programme.title: Matiere Grise
programme.desc: The magazine programme which takes the mystery out of science, encouraging us to think... without all the brain work!

programme.title: Falo
programme.desc: A news magazine show, "Falo" discusses and analyses current affairs in depth.

programme.title: Objectif Monde L'Hebdo
programme.desc: As the leading agricultural state in the United States, California relies on undocumented workers for 60% of its fruit, vegetable and nut harvests. But ICE raids and the Trump administration's anti-immigrant policies are undermining the sector. What impact does this have on this vital workforce?

programme.title: Secrets Des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Sam and Mario visit the Great Lakes, scene of a tragic maritime disaster over a century ago. A dramatic storm caused a large number of ships to founder with innumerable lives lost.

programme.title: La Belle Vie
programme.desc: Julien sets off to the Lower Saint Lawrence to meet Remi, Noemie and their little daughter Au-relie, and discover their lifestyle. Skilled wood-workers, today they occupy the house they built themselves and are able to live on the money their art brings in.

programme.title: Suisse En Scene
programme.desc: Interview with a key figure from the Swiss cultural scene. An opportunity to look back at their life and career, and the foundations that underpin their work.

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Born to a mother from the Wendat Nation and a Guinean father, Aïcha was raised in Wendake, Quebec, between African drums and Indigenous dances. A multidisciplinary artist, she defends her roots through her art and actions, and fights for the preservation of ancestral territories.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match
programme.desc: He became French champion with AS Monaco. After playing for nearly fifteen years at the highest level, football player Valere Germain has decided to end his career. He is our guest.

programme.title: Le Telejournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Hep Taxi !
programme.desc: In town or in the countryside, day or night, Jerome Colin, the presenter-taxi driver leads his prestigious customer on a four-wheel journey conducive to secrets.

programme.title: Cousu
programme.desc: Argentina has every reason to be proud of its wool, leather and many other textiles. Karine Vanasse arrives in Buenos Aires to meet designers who have a sense of style but also a concern for adapting their creations to the country's hot climate.

programme.title: Demo De Mode
programme.desc: For the Spring-Summer 2025 season, designer Imane Ayissi presents "Mssam/Assou," a haute couture collection revisiting classic couture with a variety of decorative effects crafted using African know-how.

programme.title: Tendance XXI
programme.desc: A stroll along Rue du Bac in Paris, where tradition and innovation come together with elegance. Pierres d'Histoire showcases historic residences by transforming them into holiday retreats. Dominique Imbert and Isabelle Bettan are behind this project. All about the Paris-Brest pastry. The washed look is reinventing itself on the catwalks.

programme.title: Les Rencontres Du Papotin
programme.desc: A magazine programme with a difference, along similar lines to the newspaper "Le Papotin", with an editorial team of young non-professional journalists on the autism spectrum. For each programme a well-known figure is subjected to a no-holds-barred interview. The rules are simple: anything can be said and anything can happen!

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: Parlons eco
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's new economic news bulletin, presented by Vicky Bogaert. "Parlons eco" analyses today's major trends and interviews the men and women who are starting businesses, innovating and imagining the economy of tomorrow.

programme.title: Fleuve En Eaux Troubles

programme.title: A L'Ecole Des Vetos
